coverage.summary: Covers Jersey City rental properties with 5 or more units. All 1-4 unit properties are exempt. Other exemptions under Chapter 260, which are granted when an owner files an exemption request, cannot be checked from an address lookup.

result.notes: I changed requires_unknown_facts from true to false. The ordinance covers ordinary rental buildings with 5 or more units, which assessor data can identify. The request-based exemptions it lists are unverifiable carve-outs and are kept in unverifiable_exemptions. I set other_conditions to null because its content was the same request-based exemption already listed in unverifiable_exemptions. D036 says nothing about construction-date cutoffs, owner-occupancy exemptions or new-construction exemptions for rent control. Its owner-occupied mention concerns only the state insurance requirement. Those fields stay null until the Chapter 260 text is retrieved. DX02, DX04, DX06 and DX11 concern the separate algorithmic rent-fixing ordinance (§218-12) and do not bear on Chapter 260 coverage.
